title: Maximize Meeting Earnings with Idle Gaps
statement: Given up to 10^5 meetings, each a half-open interval [start, end) with a revenue, the task is to choose a non-empty set of non-overlapping meetings maximizing total revenue plus one unit per unit of idle time between consecutive chosen meetings (none before the first or after the last). With n up to 10^5 and times up to 10^9, quadratic or time-indexed DP is too slow.
